[P2] Revisit the integration test plan for the new defaults

AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md require `tests/e2e` coverage for public API and cross-component changes, but the description explicitly defers it. The failure tests now supply `no_retry`, while the remaining retry test supplies a custom strategy; neither protects the newly selected default retry/exhaustion behavior. An absent directory does not exempt this change. Under rule 9, return to the rule-8 design phase and agree coverage for the changed defaults and their replay behavior.
